decisions.question: Reviewers rate findings P0 (blocking), P1 (should be fixed before approval) or P2 (optional). Does any finding here have to be fixed before this is approved?
Can every finding here be resolved by adding or clarifying text, without changing a figure, a rule, a date or the decision itself?

full.final:
REQ-1: The readiness gate applies only to CO-50 medical-necessity denials; denials of any other class are unaffected.
REQ-2: On a CO-50 denial, "Mark appeal packet ready" is blocked unless both are present: a non-empty clinical-note reference in DOC-### form, and a filing-deadline date. A value that is blank, whitespace, or not in DOC-### form counts as missing.
REQ-3: The filing deadline is date of service plus 90 days (Northwind Health timely filing); the system computes it from DOS and stores it as the deadline field.
REQ-4: No role may override the gate in v1; when blocked, the button label names exactly which of the two items is missing.
AC-1: CO-50, DOS 2024-03-01 gives deadline 2024-05-30, note ref DOC-204 present: button is enabled and the packet is marked ready. (Date checks: DOS 2025-01-15 gives 2025-04-15; DOS 2025-01-01 gives 2025-04-01.)
AC-2: CO-50 with deadline 2024-05-30 present but note ref blank: blocked, button reads "Add clinical note reference".
AC-3: CO-50 with deadline present and note ref "DOC-", "ABC-123", or " ": each is treated as missing, blocked, button reads "Add clinical note reference".
AC-4: CO-50 with DOC-204 present but no deadline: blocked, button reads "Add filing deadline".
AC-5: CO-50 with both items missing: blocked, button reads "Add clinical note reference and filing deadline".
AC-6: A non-CO-50 denial with both fields empty can still be marked ready.
AC-7: A specialist, and any other role, attempting to mark a blocked CO-50 packet ready (including by direct action outside the button) is refused; the packet stays not ready and no override path exists.

gated.final:
REQ-1: The readiness gate applies only to CO-50 medical-necessity denials; denials of any other class are unaffected by it.
REQ-2: On a CO-50 denial, Mark appeal packet ready is blocked unless both are present: a non-empty clinical-note id in DOC-### form, and a filing-deadline date. A blank, whitespace, or malformed value (for example " ", "DOC-", or "ABC-123") is not a DOC-### id and counts as missing.
REQ-3: The filing deadline is date of service plus 90 days (Northwind Health timely filing); the system computes it from the date of service and stores it as the deadline field.
REQ-4: No role may override the gate in v1. When blocked, the button names exactly what is missing.
AC-1: CO-50 with DOC-204 and date of service 2024-03-01 stores deadline 2024-05-30 and may be marked ready. Date of service 2025-01-15 stores 2025-04-15. Date of service 2025-01-01 stores 2025-04-01.
AC-2: CO-50 with a deadline present but note id blank, " ", "DOC-", or "ABC-123" is blocked, and the button reads "Add clinical note reference".
AC-3: CO-50 with DOC-204 and no date of service is blocked, and the button reads "Add filing deadline".
AC-4: CO-50 missing both the note id and the deadline is blocked, and the button reads "Add clinical note reference and filing deadline".
AC-5: A non-CO-50 denial with both fields empty can still be marked ready.
AC-6: A specialist or any other role who tries to bypass a blocked CO-50 fails; the packet stays not ready and there is no override path.

claude.reason: Both are factually correct (CO-50 only, DOC-### required, DOS+90 deadlines 2024-05-30, 2025-04-15 and 2025-04-01 all verified, no override), but Version 1 splits the scenarios more finely, giving blank values, malformed values, each single-missing case, the both-missing case, the non-CO-50 exemption and the override attempt their own pass/fail criteria, whereas Version 2 still bundles blank and three malformed values into one compound criterion.}

grok.reason: Version 1 is better because it isolates malformed note ids, a missing deadline, the non-CO-50 exemption, and a failed override into separate pass/fail tests, while Version 2 still bundles blank and malformed ids and tests a missing date of service rather than a missing deadline.
